m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Ah, it's you again, human. I got tired and decided to vamoose...
STOP! First you must answer for the recent Myth Monster attack. What was it? Retaliation for our failing to protect your Athanor cousins?
Attack? You big, blue ox, you think we're riling up the Mythies? They're overrunning our towns. I came here to get YOUR help with them.
Interesting. Is it not possible the Dark Cloud is raising the monsters against you both? I believe it warrants investigation.
Sparck! My boy, that may be it! But you must not go! I need the mind behind the Spiral Ark to remain here for a project critical to Nimbus.
Is that so? Very... well. Wizard, you can handle this task alone. My duty to my people comes before my duty to the Captain. Good luck.
Nimbari, right? Anyhow, sounds like you need a lift. Just hop on board the old Aeroship. Don't worry, I'm an excellent pilot.
Welcome, Wizard, to the crown jewel of Neumia... Port Aero.
Now you've met the Dark Cloud, a band of militant pacifists seeking to turn us from Raven's path.
Yes, his actions inspired many to treason. They used to merely take credit for a few sparse attacks, but lately, they've been getting bold.
I suspect they're based in the Aero Plains, given their Myth Monster war beasts. I sent a Justicar squad to investigate. They never returned.
What's that, Wizard? You met a Dwarf from the Aero Plains on your way to the Central Spire? Hmm, he appears to have left.
An Aero Dwarf was here during the attack? I've oft said they were fomenting the Myth Beasts against us. We must find him before he leaves Nimbus.
